quarterly_data.signal: Linde's second-quarter 2026 earnings release lists a project backlog of $11 billion; Linde Engineering's order intake for the quarter was $871 million and its third-party sale of equipment backlog was $3.0 billion. Second-quarter capital expenditures were $1,438 million, and full-year 2026 capital expenditures are expected in the range of $5.5 billion to $6.0 billion to support growth and maintenance requirements including the $8.1 billion contractual sale of gas project backlog. Guidance: third-quarter 2026 adjusted diluted EPS of $4.45 to $4.55 and full-year 2026 adjusted diluted EPS of $17.70 to $17.90.
quarterly_data.figure: project backlog $11 billion; sale of equipment backlog $3.0 billion (order intake $871 million); Q2 capex $1,438 million; FY2026 capex guide $5.5 billion to $6.0 billion; FY2026 adjusted EPS guide $17.70 to $17.90; Q3 $4.45 to $4.55
